### 5. Diversify Your Portfolio
Diversification is key to managing risk. Spread your investments across different asset classes (stocks, bonds, real estate, etc.) and sectors to reduce the impact of any single investment's performance on your overall portfolio. This strategy can help mitigate risk while potentially increasing returns.
